description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art head, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: put the same thing on both heads, in the same place on each: a broad red folding-fan pin with gold ribs and one short gold tassel, entirely above the left ear (seen from behind, the same pin above that ear). Simple bold shapes. Keep the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The head, the face and the ears stay exactly as they are, nothing else added, transparent background.
